message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: High person (高某某) knows he has obligation to execute a civil judgment (from March 22, 2013) and during execution he intentionally hides assets, causing the judgment to be unenforceable. This is classic "拒不执行判决、裁定" (refusal to comply with judgment) or "隐匿财产、逃避执行" which under Chinese criminal law is "拒不执行判决、裁定罪" (refusal to execute judgment). In examples earlier, there is a case: "拒不执行判决、裁定" given for a similar scenario. So answer: [罪名]拒不执行判决、裁定<eoa>. Possibly also "隐匿财产罪"? But Chinese law: "拒不执行判决、裁定罪" includes concealment of property. So single crime.

Thus final answer: [罪名]拒不执行判决、裁定<eoa>
